#   search         the query                                 top 10 for the query
#   upsert         the document text                         write a new doc (or a new version of doc_id)
#   wait_visible   query (empty = the doc's upserted text)   poll until the doc is searchable: the REAL freshness lag
#   wait_gone      query (empty = the doc's upserted text)   poll until a deleted doc is gone
#   migrate        model (empty = bge-small)                 start building a new embedding model on every shard
#   wait_ready     model (empty = bge-small)                 wait until the new model is built everywhere
#   cutover        model (empty = bge-small)                 switch queries to that model
#   rollback       empty                                     switch back to the previous model
#   finalize       model to drop (empty = the one kept for rollback)   end the migration
#   flush          empty                                     wait until async writes are all applied
#   status         empty                                     record every shard's state
#   kill_shard     shard number                              CRASH a shard (only with --start-cluster)
#   restart_shard  shard number                              restart it; it replays its WAL
#   sleep          seconds                                   pause (usually t_ms is easier)
